Return a list where each position equals the product of all input values except that position. Do not use division. For a one-element list return [1]; [] returns [].

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      2,
      3,
      4
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    12,
    8,
    6
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      0,
      3,
      0
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    0,
    0,
    0
  ]
}
Hint

Combine the product to the left with the product to the right.

Complexity: O(n) arithmetic operations, O(n) output and O(1) auxiliary variables
